Mummy ka birthday Fri 30 Oct ko hai, to cake kal tak order kar do, especially agar custom chahiye. 🎂

Kuch achhe options:

Safe pick: butterscotch, pineapple ya black forest, sabko pasand aate hain
Rich: chocolate truffle ya red velvet
Special touch: photo cake, ya upar "Happy Birthday Mummy" likhwa do
Halka: fruit cake ya sugar-free, agar meetha kam khaati hain

Eggless chahiye ya nahi, ye order se pehle confirm kar lena. Mummy ko aam taur par kaunsa flavour pasand hai?
